summary: Bertholdt falls on Shiganshina inside a barrel and becomes the Colossal. The town burns. Armin is left with a plan that will cost his body.

segments.ja: 雷槍の煙がまだ残るシガンシナに、桶が落ちます。落ちる桶は、荷物ではありません。荷物ではなく、ベルトルトです。ベルトルトは、壁の上から自分の体を容器に入れて待っていました。待っていた落下を、ハンジは予測の一つとして持っていました。持っていた予測が、今、屋根の上で音になります。音のあと、街は熱の予告を受けます。受ける熱は、まだ巨人の姿ではありません。
segments.en: Onto Shiganshina, where the thunder spears' smoke still remains, a barrel falls. The barrel that falls is not luggage. It is not luggage. It is Bertholdt. From the wall, Bertholdt had been waiting with his own body put inside a container. Hange had the waiting fall as one of her predictions. The prediction she had becomes a sound now on a roof. After the sound, the town receives a notice of heat. The heat it receives is not yet a Titan's form.

segments.ja: 桶から出たベルトルトは、まだ人間の声で話します。話す相手は、アルミンと、エレンと、班です。班は、声を聞きながら距離を測ります。測る理由は、変身の瞬間に近すぎれば死ぬ、です。死ぬ半径を、アルミンは記憶の蒸気から計算します。計算するあいだも、ベルトルトは同期の名を呼びます。呼ぶ名は、和解ではありません。自分の決断を、相手に聞かせる時間です。
segments.en: Bertholdt, who came out of the barrel, still speaks in a human voice. The people he speaks to are Armin, Eren, and the squad. The squad measures distance while hearing the voice. The reason they measure is that if they are too near at the moment of the transformation, they die. Armin calculates the radius of dying from the steam in memory. Even while he calculates, Bertholdt calls the classmates' names. The names he calls are not a reconciliation. It is time to let the other side hear his own decision.

segments.ja: アルミンは、ベルトルトの注意を自分に残す役を引き受けます。引き受ける理由は、エレンとミカサを変身の中心から外す、です。外す会話は、友人のふりではありません。ふりではなく、相手の迷いを一秒延ばす技術です。技術の声は、穏やかです。穏やかな声の下で、彼は死の半径の内側に足を置きます。置く足が、光臨の犠牲の最初です。最初を、彼は自分で選びます。
segments.en: Armin takes on the role of keeping Bertholdt's attention on himself. The reason he takes it on is to move Eren and Mikasa out of the center of the transformation. The conversation that moves them is not a pretense of friends. It is not a pretense. It is a technique that extends the opponent's hesitation by one second. The voice of the technique is calm. Under the calm voice, he puts his feet inside the radius of death. The feet he puts are the first sacrifice of the descent. He chooses the first himself.

segments.ja: ベルトルトが変身すると、シガンシナの一角が光で焼けます。焼ける光は、壁の穴の日の再来です。再来の中心に、アルミンがいます。いるアルミンは、蒸気で体を奪われます。奪われた体を、班はすぐに拾えません。拾えない理由は、超大型の熱が周囲を無人にする、です。無人になった屋根の上に、巨大な姿が立ちます。立つ姿が、光臨です。光臨は、祝福の言葉ではありません。光のあと、屋根の瓦が遅れて落ちます。落ちた瓦の音が、熱の半径を教えます。
segments.en: When Bertholdt transforms, one corner of Shiganshina burns in light. The light that burns is the return of the day of the hole in the wall. Armin is at the center of the return. The Armin who is there has his body taken by steam. The squad cannot pick up at once the body that was taken. The reason they cannot pick it up is that the Colossal's heat empties the surroundings. On the emptied roof, an enormous form stands. The form that stands is the descent. Descent is not a word of blessing. After the light, roof tiles fall late. The sound of the tiles that fell teaches the radius of the heat.

segments.en: Outside the light, Eren searches for Armin's name. The eyes that search can confirm nothing because of the heat. While he cannot confirm, he holds down the impulse to transform. The reason he holds it down is that if he becomes a Titan here and now, he burns the house and his companions at the same time. Levi's procedure stops the temptation to burn. The procedure that stops is: leave the Colossal to Armin's plan, and we look at what remains of the Armor. The division of looking is the squad's shape after the descent.

segments.en: Bertholdt, who has become the Colossal, no longer speaks in a classmate's voice. The form that does not speak straddles the town in one step. The heat of straddling does not let a blade arrive. He uses the distance that does not arrive as his own weapon. The resolve to use it had ended inside the barrel. The descent only carries out the resolve that had ended. The burned body of Armin is included among the opponents it carries out against. He has accepted the inclusion as a necessity of the mission.

segments.en: Eren's house is off the center of the descent. Being off is today's arrangement inside misfortune. Armin bought the arrangement with his own position. The squad cannot yet use the arrangement he bought. The reason they cannot is that the Colossal has occupied the center of the town. Beyond the heat that occupied it is the basement's door. Running to the door is death now. During the death, the page is not yet burning. Not burning is the only remainder. The door's position is still the same even beyond the smoke. Eren confirms the same position with his eyes alone.

segments.ja: 光臨と同時に、壁の上の獣は投擲の準備を進めます。進める投擲は、平地の兵団を対象にします。対象を、エルヴィンは自分の目で確定します。確定した瞬間、奪還は二つの全滅のあいだに入ります。入る二つの敵は、超大型と獣です。獣の石は、まだ飛んでいません。飛んでいない予告が、団長の名簿を焼きます。焼く予告を、街の光が同時に出します。

segments.en: After the steam, Armin can hardly move. His companions cannot leave the body that cannot move until the heat thins. The place they cannot leave him is at the Colossal's feet. The work of pulling him away from the feet is the first half of the next episode of the hero. Before the first half, this descent fixes him in the position of a sacrifice. At the edge of consciousness, he still uses the fixed position for a calculation. The calculation he uses is to make his own body the completion of a decoy. The completion does not include survival.

segments.en: Even split by the thunder spears, the Armor still remains in the town. The reason it remains is time to support Bertholdt's descent. Eren's side has not yet been able to finish that time. Without being able to finish it, two Titans pinch the town. The arrangement of pinching splits the Survey Corps. The split squad cannot look at the Armor and the Colossal at the same time. Not being able to look is the tactic of the descent. The tactic uses friends' faces split into two. Between the two Titans, the wind changes once. The changed wind pushes the smoke toward the line.

segments.en: Hange looks at the heat of the descent as if measuring it. The eyes that look hold a researcher's excitement and a section commander's loss at the same time. With the two eyes she holds, she draws a line of withdrawal. The line she draws is outside the Colossal's steam. There are already soldiers who cannot be sent outside. segments.en: Shiganshina is the town where everything began, and at the same time it burns today. Among the houses that burn, only Eren's house is still off to the side. Nobody celebrates the luck of being off. The reason they do not celebrate is that Armin is inside the light. The fact that he is there is the center of the descent. The next episode turns the center into a hero's action. Before it turns, this episode leaves only the fall and the heat. The heat that remains is the sound of the end of classmates' friendship. Beyond the burned corner, only the outline of the house remains. Nobody celebrates yet the outline that remained.
